subject: SVGLoop (real project: svg-animate-check)
what_it_is: A browser-based SVG keyframe-loop animator (Next.js, 66 commits May-June 2024, Guerrilla-Interactive/svg-animate-check locally). Paste an SVG, stack keyframes of its path states on a drag-sortable timeline (dnd-kit), morph between them (flubber + anime.js beta + GSAP in deps), then hit Export Loop: it code-generates a self-contained React component with the keyframes JSON baked in and an anime.js timeline set to loop:true. The GitHub repo FRIKKern-visible as Guerrilla-Interactive/svgloop-svelte is a red herring: one commit (2024-07-15), untouched create-svelte demo template (sverdle and all) - the Svelte rewrite that never began; only the name survived.
the_intent: The itch: looping SVG animations for client sites are absurdly fiddly - you hand-tune keyframes in code, reload, squint, repeat. Frikk built the inspection loop as a product: see the morph live on a canvas, reorder keyframes by dragging, fix the viewBox with one button, then export working component code instead of a lossy GIF or a fragile CSS file. It is the same instinct that later becomes Scaffy: capture a repeated hand-chore as a tool that emits the finished artifact.
delight_details: ExportSVG emits a ready-to-paste React component: keyframes serialized as JSON inside the file, anime.timeline({loop:true}) driving path morphs - the tool's output is code, not video

FitViewBoxButton computes the optimal viewBox across ALL keyframes and detects whether frames are already consistent (calculateOptimalViewBox, ViewBoxButton.tsx:58-99) - the classic 'my SVG is clipped mid-animation' pain, one click
A DummyPointButton exists to inject throwaway points - a tell that he fought path-point-count mismatch (morphing needs equal point counts) head-on
Commit log reads like a solo sprint diary: 'Giga Refactor - v3' (2024-06-04), 'Better History UX', 'Adding darkmode and stuff', ending 2024-06-18 'Better darkmode'

subject: Spreadsheet Wizard
what_it_is: sanity-plugin-spreadsheet-wizard v0.0.96 (Guerrilla-Interactive, Apr-Jun 2022, JS, co-authored 'Frikk Jarl & Suman Chapai - Frikk@guerrilla.no'). A Sanity Studio plugin that is 'a fantastic bridge between Sanity & your spreadsheet software of choice (Google Sheets... Excel... Numbers etc.)': export Sanity documents to CSV/TSV field-by-field, edit in any spreadsheet app, import back - with a preview-while-import step, type handling (slugs, numbers, booleans, advanced types as JSON), unsetting fields when a value is missing, and batching large data 'in bundles to avoid sanity api limit error'. Sibling repos spreadsheet-test (empty) and spreadsheet-testo (427KB JS) were created the same day as the first plugin commits (2022-04-17) - scratch sandboxes for the same push.
the_intent: Agency reality, 2022: clients live in spreadsheets, content lives in a headless CMS, and someone at Guerrilla was manually copy-pasting between them. The wizard turned bulk content ops - translate 200 titles, fix 500 slugs - into export, edit in Excel, import. The 'wizard' is both the walk-through UI (pick fields, preview data, confirm) and the self-aware branding: the README calls it 'a magnificient tool' with a straight face. It is Frikk's first recorded run at the idea that spreadsheets are the universal human editing surface for structured content - the same idea that returns four years later as Barkpark's Sheets plugin (multi-tab A1 cell maps, xlsx/csv/tsv import AND export, formula engine, snapshot embeds in papers), now server-side and first-party instead of bolted onto someone else's CMS.

subject: Full Blast (repo: frickin-real-time)
what_it_is: A 3D action-roguelite swarm shooter (TypeScript + Three.js + Vite, local repo frickin-real-time; browser title still 'KAMIKAZE - Survive the Explosions'). You fight escalating waves of swarming enemies, TechnoBots and royal bosses; collect five weapons WITH DURABILITY (Battle Axe, Greatsword, Arcane Staff, Machine Gun, Twin Blades - they break mid-fight), grenades, missiles, XP crystals, hearts, and 20 bonus runes (Double Shot, Chain Lightning, Vampiric Bullets, Doomblaster, El Granados, Slideshow, Super Dash, Multimark...). The name: kill-chains climb a 20-tier announcement ladder - CHAIN REACTION (3 kills) through EXPLOSION FRENZY, MEGA BLAST, RAGNAROK, APOCALYPSE, up to tier 20, 600 kills / 3,000,000 damage: 'FULL BLAST ERADICATION' in white, filling the screen. The game is named after its own maximum moment. A full Godot 4.6.3 port lives in godot/ - 822 .gd files, gamepad-first, deterministic sim, and design verdicts that deliberately outgrow the web original.
the_intent: This is the joy project - the game where every system exists to make the screen feel ALIVE at 600 kills per chain. The web version proved the fantasy; the Godot port is where Frikk applies everything he learned building Barkpark to game development: MAP.md routing docs per directory, pinned constants asserted against source-truth.json, a determinism gate, zero-alloc pools, an 'honest playtest' harness, and binding DESIGN_VERDICTS that overrule the port specs when feel wins ('Fortnite, not WoW'; 'web parity is a starting point, not a contract'). One repo, two eras of the same person.

subject: Scaffy
what_it_is: 'Commands as content' inside Barkpark: a .scaffy file is a declarative, idempotent, REVERSIBLE scaffolding document. It doesn't just create files - it injects the wiring generators never reach (registries, routers, barrels, config maps), plants a named MARK at every injection site so re-runs are no-ops and removal is exact, and closes by running the repo's own gates so green means the slice compiles. Catalog of 22 commands (add-block-type flagship spanning Go+Elixir+JS surfaces; ensure-* zone planters for the repo's worst accretion files; add-site-template births a 13-file Astro site template plus 13 injections across 12 files) + 2 recipes, built over 7 waves, frequency-MINED from 12 months of git history so every command answers a proven repetition (router.ex: 175 commits/12mo; errors.ex: 38 clause-adds; sdk method chore: 34 commits).
the_intent: The sinnsyk idea, in one stranger-sized paragraph: when an AI agent (or a human) needs to add a route, an error code, a worker, a whole site template, it should not hand-edit eight files from memory and hope - it should reach for a measured, versioned CATALOG of repeatable operations, the way you reach for a package manager instead of copying code off a forum. Each operation is a document you can read, validate, run, re-run harmlessly, and reverse exactly; and the catalog is not faith-based - Frikk pre-registered a benchmark, spent $17.19 of real agent money, and measured that the engine reproduces the agent's work byte-for-byte at $0 in seconds. 'Every fact has one owner; every derived surface is collected, generated, or applied by a command - never maintained by hand.' Lineage: Frikk says 'Nextgen er basically Scaffy' - Guerrilla's Nextgen generator (nextgen-vscode, nextgen-markers, Nextgen-UI repos) was the same reflex years earlier: markers planted in code so a tool, not a human, threads new features into existing files. Scaffy is that idea reborn with doctrine, grammar, an engine, receipts, and a benchmark.
delight_details: The north-star demo: 'bp add block-type --var BlockName=timeline' -> a vertical slice across 3 languages with test parity, in 28 seconds - 'the fast path IS the standard path - standards become executable'
Wave 1 shipped the corpus deliberately WITHOUT an engine: full-text commands a human could hand-apply, which then became the parser's test fixtures - the spec written as examples

The ensure law (D57) was RUN-PROVEN: guarded on the MARK comment the engine duplicated a hand-planted import; guarded on the payload line it skipped clean - so the law is 'guard on what a hand-edit would also produce'

The mis-grep tripwire in scaffy-mine: errors.ex uses private 'defp build(' - grepping public 'def build(' returns 0 and would silently claim no accretion; the miner prints the wrong number BESIDE the right one so the trap stays visible

Honesty records everywhere: the charter's 739 router-partner figure was DROPPED when the reproducible miner couldn't reproduce it; the benchmark paper reports the ~$0.55 spawn floor, the partial-coverage tax and the boundary staging leak against its own predictions

The boundary duel (where Scaffy is DESIGNED to lose) got contaminated: 3 of 4 agents noticed the re-planted bug was an uncommitted revert of a committed fix and just restored HEAD with git - recorded in full, verdict 'not scoreable as registered'
add-plugin-bucket depends on ensure-router-zones BY LOUD REFUSAL: absent anchors exit 5, nothing written - run-proven that refusal + a 2-run recipe beats inventing a composition primitive
Doctrine reached the docs: docs/cards/cli.md tells every agent 'Scaffy catalog-first' with the measured numbers inline

subject: Bulldocs origin (Portable Docs + Paperflow -> Bulldocs)
what_it_is: Barkpark's Papers surface, born from two separate inventions merging. Invention 1, portable-doc-mvp: 'One semantic document -> deterministic, beautiful output across Web, Native, Email, TUI, and plain text' - a closed AST of 10 block types with an intersection-schema validator (if a property can't survive Email or an 80-col TUI it's rejected at edit time), one compose kernel, thin per-surface adapters, an MCP server, 445 specs (wave D). Invention 2, paperflow: 'Turn a one-line Goal into a planned, grilled, built, and reviewed change - with HTML you can read at every step' - the process engine that made agents produce beautiful readable papers as their working artifacts (retired as a standalone stack 2026-07-24). Bulldocs is the fusion inside Barkpark: PortableDoc contributed the document format and rendering discipline (core Barkpark.PortableDoc.{Render,Patch,Projection,Synthesis}); Paperflow contributed the culture and the pipeline - agents publishing every plan, benchmark, doctrine and survey as a paper. The lineage is literally in the router: /v1/paperflow/* still aliases /v1/plugins/bulldocs/* for legacy producers, gated 'do NOT drop'.
the_intent: Why it might be 'det aller mest imponerende innenfor Barkpark': it changed what an AI-built system's paper trail IS. Instead of markdown files rotting in a repo, every piece of thinking - plans, benchmarks, doctrines, incident reports - is a structured, validated, multi-surface document served from the platform itself, readable in a browser, a terminal, an email. The corpus is now 603 published papers, and it is treated like production data: when several renderers showed empty shells (text nested one object layer deeper than readers expected), Frikk ran a full structural-integrity operation - census of 600 papers, 316 affected, 7,942 violations - and repaired ALL of them with exact JSON backups, pinned revisions, dry-run-default idempotent transforms, then sealed the write paths fail-closed and published the post-mortem as, of course, a paper.
delight_details: The intersection-schema idea: the weakest surface (Email / 80-col TUI) vetoes properties at EDIT time - portability enforced by construction, not by per-surface hacks
bp paper view renders papers in the terminal with letterspaced display headings (S C A F F Y . T H E W 6 B E N C H M A R K...) - the TUI is a first-class reading surface, not a fallback

The composition-doctrine paper builds a recursive authoring vocabulary - Element -> Widget -> Section -> Layout -> Document - with 'Template is NOT a tier - it is the save-as-reusable capability any node has at any scale'

The mechanical-spacing doctrine: 'a gap exists because the author typed it' - vertical rhythm stored as real blocks (Enter/Shift+Enter), not CSS margins, so web, editor, TUI and clipboard share one shape; and the paper carries its own frozen editorial review on top

The repair wave's discipline: initial census 600 papers / 316 affected / 7,942 violations -> final census 603 / 0 / 0, with stable manifests and digests both runs, a zero-mutation second plan as proof of idempotence, sealed by PRs #8105 and #8137

Papers eat their own dogfood recursively: the integrity incident about papers is documented as a paper; the scaffy benchmark payload is checked into the repo and byte-matches what the server serves (D18 reproducibility)

subject: Barkpark Cloud
what_it_is: One person's actual cloud platform: the control plane at barkpark.cloud (cloud/ - an Elixir app with accounts, billing, registry, sites, templates, provisioning workers, domain_ownership, device_auth, oauth, cloudflare/azure/vercel/github integrations) that provisions REAL Hetzner servers and runs hosted sites on them. Launch/go-live provisioning brings a box from nothing to serving; hosted sites ship with a builder + runtime; attach-domain V2 does DNS-ownership proof before binding a customer domain; grant_forever mints comp licences; cp-ops is a dedicated operator lane. Deployment of the platform itself is grown-up: path-filtered GitHub Actions, blue/green slots on BOTH the control plane (compose profiles :4100/:4101) and the content instance (systemd slots :4000/:4001), health-gated Caddy flips, zero-downtime either way, branded 503 maintenance pages baked into every provisioned box, and a 169-check offline test harness for the deploy script itself.
the_intent: The point a stranger should get: this is not 'deployed a side project to a VPS'. It is the whole Heroku-shaped stack - signup, billing, provisioning, fleet dashboard, domains, templates, operator tooling - built solo so that Barkpark instances and customer sites are one command from existing. And it is self-hosting in the proudest sense: jarl.no, Frikk's own site, became the first real site on a fresh box - and that shakedown cruise surfaced 7 platform gaps which were found and fixed in ONE day. The UI blueprint shows the same maturity turned inward: 'the capability spine works, but the product feels like things were added randomly... the fix is fewer things, better placed, quieter - deletion and consolidation are first-class moves', with 'the novice is the persona; ease of mind first' as chartered law.
delight_details: add-site-template (Scaffy) births a complete deployable cloud site template in one run: a 13-file Astro starter tree plus all 13 catalog-family injections across 12 files, closed by the repo's own drift gates - the platform's site catalog is itself a scaffolded surface
The deploy path filter diffs from the last SUCCESSFUL workflow run, not the previous push - burst merges coalesce and the surviving run deploys the UNION, while a docs-only stretch is still a no-op
Every Caddy site block ships a branded 'Back in a moment' 503 with Retry-After - no provisioned customer box can ever show a raw 502
The MCP route (/mcp -> :4010) holds NO token anywhere on the box - forward-through auth, the caller's own bearer is the only credential, bogus ones fail closed downstream
The cloud console SPA pair (app.js + its node test harness) carries 438+ tests running in ~250ms with zero deps - and Scaffy plants named zones in it
Design docs written to be RATIFIED: DESIGN.md marks two items 'RATIFY:' - they need a human yes before the CSS slices execute
